description: This PHP class defines a controller for editing social media authentication providers within the OrangeHRM OpenID Authentication plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up a Vue component with an optional 'id' property based on the request attributes.

classes.name: EditSocialMediaAuthProviderController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for rendering the Vue component to edit social media authentication providers, with logic to include the 'id' property if specified in the request.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering, adding an 'id' property if one is present in the request attributes.
